name: Siva Rama Krishnan
title: Global Talent Consultant
bio: Astute, tenacious, and highly accomplished business professional with progressive experience in the recruitment industry. Armed with more than 15 years of verifiable success in areas of recruitment, business development, marketing, client servicing, and sales operations. Adept in the swift resolution of problems, fulfillment of customer requirements, and management of operations. Lead productive and multi-disciplinary teams with confidence and is able to negotiate efficiently with a wide range of stakeholders to secure best possible terms and results. Highly dependable and always committed to achieving operational goals, standards, and targets.
description: Business professional with more than 15 years in recruitment and business development.
